request.initial_prompt: It opened slowly: a figure came out into the twilight and stood on the step; a man without a hat: he stretched forth his hand as if to feel whether it rained. Dusk as it was, I had recognised him—it was my master, Edward Fairfax Rochester, and no other.

raw_segments.text: It opened slowly—a figure came out into the twilight and stood on the step—a man without
a hat—he stretched forth his hand as if to feel whether it rained. Dusk as it was,
I had recognised him—it was my master, Edward Fairfax Rochester, and no other.

It opened slowly. A figure came out into the twilight and stood on the step. A man without a hat. He stretched forth his hand as if to feel whether it reigned. Dusk as it was, I had recognized him. It was my master, Edward Fairfax Rochester, and no other.
